correctness.rationale: Explicit derivative and boundary factorization prove the exact smooth and singular ranges. Hasse–Witt coefficient extraction yields an invertible 2x2 Frobenius block on ab≠1 and a one-dimensional Cartier kernel. Two commuting involution quotients have supersingular elliptic and ordinary genus-two factors. On ab=1, triple roots become ordinary cusps unless a4=1, when two squares split into rational graphs and two tacnodes; normalization and local-units exact sequences yield Ga² extension or Gm×Ga² respectively. Elliptic quartic Hasse coefficient determines the four supersingular cuspidal fibers. Symbolic tests reproduce polynomial identities, not substitute for universal proof.
